description.value: An event-related fMRI study compared cue-induced gaming urge and smoking craving in subjects with comorbid Internet gaming addiction and nicotine dependence and control subjects.

spans.text: Thus, the present fMRI study is aimed at comparing the brain activity observed in the response to gaming cues and smoking cues, and determining whether the brain activity elicited by gaming cues is similar to that elicited by smoking cues in subjects with concurrent IGA and nicotine dependence.
